direction.mechanics: four descent-specific drawings alternate RIGHT contact → LEFT passing → LEFT contact → RIGHT passing; approved V16 roots retained in reverse spatial order with 0.25-lp regressions clamped forward

sizeRegistration.method: door-hidden change from normal room scale to one constant stair-circulation scale; native approved stair frames remain unscaled
sizeRegistration.departureHandoff: completed while Keeper is fully behind the lower room door before visible travel
sizeRegistration.arrivalHandoff: reset only after Keeper is fully behind the upper room door
sizeRegistration.visibleRouteScaleRule: all walk, turn, bridge and reach frames use circulationArtScale; all Stair V16 frames use native scale 1
